title: Participant
description: A protocol v1 task participant. The ID is independent; the role is declared as its own field, not derived from the ID.

id.description: The participant's independent ID. A role is never derived from it.

role.description: An extensible role slug: the core does not keep a list of roles.

harness.description: The tool the participant's session lives in. Required: v1 has no fallback.

mode.description: managed — the driver spawned the session; attached — it connected on its own.

sessionRef.description: The driver's opaque session reference. An explicit null, not a missing field.

capabilities.description: A snapshot of the driver's capabilities at spawn time. The last four fields are optional: older records without them sit in live journals and must remain readable.

metadata.description: The adapter's metadata: the core never looks inside it.
